title: Divisors of Binomial Coefficient
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Find the number, modulo $998244353$, of positive divisors of a binomial coefficient $\displaystyle \binom{N}{K}$.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 10^{12}$
- $0 \leq K \leq \min(10^6,N)$
- All values in input are integers.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N K
```

## Output

Print the answer.

samples.note: We have $\displaystyle \binom{5}{2}=10$, which has four positive divisors: $1,2,5,10$.
We have $\displaystyle \binom{103}{3}=176851$, which has eight positive divisors.
